cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_sensitive_string_output
cases.description: A captured state with a sensitive string output whose value the random_password resource holds too, a non-sensitive output, a data source, a resource with sensitive values and child modules: each flagged value is hidden, and so is the whole output named password, by its key.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_deposed_object
cases.description: A captured state holding a tainted object and a deposed object at one address, each marked by its own sensitive_values.

cases.name: terraform_state_after_a_change
cases.description: A captured state after an apply that changed, renamed and imported resources.

cases.name: terraform_state_verified_after_the_deployment
cases.description: A captured state, the one a deployment checked after it settled was held to.

cases.name: terraform_state_read_by_a_refresh_only_plan
cases.description: The prior_state of the second refresh-only plan of the same deployment, the state the post-verify stage's identities were read from: for a state that did not change, the same digest as the state itself.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_sensitive_object_and_list_outputs_copied_unmarked
cases.description: A sensitive object output and a sensitive list output, whose member strings a resource holds unmarked: every string inside them is hidden wherever it appears.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_sensitive_value_in_a_child_module
cases.description: A resource of a child module whose sensitive_values flags one attribute.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_nested_sensitive_values
cases.description: sensitive_values that flag one key of a map, one item of a list, and a whole object.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_sensitive_value_in_a_data_source
cases.description: A data source whose sensitive_values flags one attribute.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_non_string_sensitive_output_and_a_non_sensitive_output
cases.description: A sensitive number output, hidden, and a non-sensitive string output, kept.

cases.name: terraform_state_that_is_empty
cases.description: A state that holds nothing, with no values and no terraform_version.

cases.name: terraform_state_written_by_one_terraform_version
cases.description: A small state as one Terraform version writes it.

cases.name: terraform_state_written_by_another_terraform_version
cases.description: The same state as another Terraform version, with another format version, writes it: the same digest.

cases.name: terraform_state_under_a_policy_with_an_additional_path
cases.description: A policy whose additional path tags.owner hides that value under each resource's values, and nowhere else.

cases.name: terraform_state_under_a_policy_with_an_exempt_path
cases.description: A policy whose exempt path keeps a value the deny rule would hide, with its reason.

exempt_paths.reason: the hint is checked for its length

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_value_shaped_like_a_credential
cases.description: A value no flag marks, hidden because it is shaped like a credential: a URL with a password in it.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_check_results
cases.description: A captured state of a resource with a postcondition and a check block, with their results under checks: accepted, checks left out unread, the same digest as the same state without checks.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_check_results_left_out
cases.description: The captured state with check results, without its checks key.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_failed_check_holding_a_secret
cases.description: A failed check whose problems hold a key shaped like a credential and a copy of a sensitive output's value: not refused, and checks is never searched, so the copy there hides nothing elsewhere.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_failed_check_left_out
cases.description: The state with a failed check, without its checks key.

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_resource_that_names_no_sensitive_values
cases.description: Refused: a resource entry with no sensitive_values key, which the tool writes for every resource.
cases.refused: every resource names its sensitive values, as the tool writes them; the resource at values.root_module.resources[0] names none

cases.name: terraform_state_that_is_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: a state that is a list.
cases.refused: a state is a JSON object

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_unknown_top_level_key
cases.description: Refused: a top-level key other than format_version, terraform_version, values and checks.
cases.refused: a state holds no top-level key other than format_version, terraform_version, values and checks; it holds resource_changes

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_unknown_top_level_key_shaped_like_a_credential
cases.description: Refused, without naming the key: a top-level key shaped like a credential (a run digest key token).
cases.refused: a state holds no top-level key other than format_version, terraform_version, values and checks

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_unknown_key_under_values_that_is_not_a_plain_identifier
cases.description: Refused, without naming the key: a key under values with characters other than letters, digits and _.
cases.refused: the values of a state hold no key other than root_module and outputs

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_values_are_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: values is a list.
cases.refused: the values of a state are an object

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_unknown_key_under_values
cases.description: Refused: a key under values other than root_module and outputs.
cases.refused: the values of a state hold no key other than root_module and outputs; they hold checks

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_outputs_are_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: outputs is a list.
cases.refused: the outputs of a state are an object of outputs, each an object

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_output_that_is_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: an output that is a string.
cases.refused: the outputs of a state are an object of outputs, each an object

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_root_module_is_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: root_module is a list.
cases.refused: the module at values.root_module of the state is an object

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_resources_are_not_a_list
cases.description: Refused: resources is an object.
cases.refused: the resources of the module at values.root_module of the state are a list of objects

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_resource_that_is_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: a resource entry that is a string.
cases.refused: the resources of the module at values.root_module of the state are a list of objects

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_sensitive_values_are_of_another_type
cases.description: Refused: sensitive_values that is a string, neither an object, a list nor a boolean.
cases.refused: the sensitive values of the resource at values.root_module.resources[0] hold only objects, lists and booleans

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_sensitive_values_hold_a_flag_that_is_not_a_boolean
cases.description: Refused: a flag inside sensitive_values that is a string, not true or false.
cases.refused: the sensitive values of the resource at values.root_module.resources[0] hold only objects, lists and booleans

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_output_that_does_not_say_whether_it_is_sensitive
cases.description: Refused: an output with no sensitive key.
cases.refused: every output of a state says whether it is sensitive, true or false

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_output_whose_sensitive_flag_is_not_a_boolean
cases.description: Refused: an output whose sensitive is the string true.
cases.refused: every output of a state says whether it is sensitive, true or false

cases.name: terraform_state_with_an_integer_beyond_the_canonical_range
cases.description: Refused: a value with no canonical form, an integer beyond 2**53, so the state has no digest.
cases.refused: an integer is outside the range JSON numbers hold exactly

cases.name: terraform_state_whose_child_modules_are_not_a_list
cases.description: Refused: child_modules is an object.
cases.refused: the child modules of the module at values.root_module of the state are a list

cases.name: terraform_state_with_a_child_module_that_is_not_an_object
cases.description: Refused: a child module that is a string.
cases.refused: the module at values.root_module.child_modules[0] of the state is an object

cases.name: terraform_state_holding_a_planted_redaction_marker
cases.description: Refused: a state that already holds a whole redaction marker in a value.
cases.refused: the state holds an object at values.root_module.resources[0].values.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes

cases.name: terraform_state_holding_a_planted_unknown_marker
cases.description: Refused: a state that already holds a whole unknown marker in a value.
cases.refused: the state holds an object at values.root_module.resources[0].values.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes

cases.name: terraform_state_holding_a_marker_lookalike
cases.description: Refused: a state that already holds an object with the redaction marker's key and other keys in a value.
cases.refused: the state holds an object at values.root_module.resources[0].values.input that a reader could take for a redaction or unknown marker, which only redaction writes
